title: File:Kansas State Capitol.jpg
desc: The State Capitol building of Topeka, Kansas. Taken with a Panasonic DMC-TZ3.

title: File:Dome, Kansas State Capitol, 8th Avenue and Van Buren Street, Topeka, KS - 54461296488.jpg
desc: Built in 1866-1903, this Renaissance Revival-style building was designed by Edward Townsend Mix and John G. Haskell to serve as the Kansas State Capitol.
